admission.intro: Admission follows six steps. Requirements follow the rules of the board or university for each programme.

steps.title: Counselling and enquiry
steps.body: Visit the college office or admission desk to ask about programmes and get counselling.

steps.title: Eligibility
steps.body: For +2: SEE or equivalent with the required GPA and subject prerequisites. For a bachelor's programme: +2 or equivalent in a relevant stream, following university rules.

steps.title: Application
steps.body: Submit the application with your transcripts, character certificate, recent photographs and a copy of your citizenship.

steps.title: Selection
steps.body: Selection is merit-based under the board or university rules. Some programmes may add an interview or orientation counselling.

steps.title: Scholarships
steps.body: Merit-based and need-based scholarships are available. The Scholarships page says who can apply.

steps.title: Enrolment
steps.body: Complete the fee formalities and attend an orientation session to finalise subject choices and class schedules.

scholarships.intro: Scholarships are merit-based and need-based, and are confirmed after the college verifies the details.

items.title: Need-based
items.body: Awarded to students who need financial support.

items.title: Dalit students
items.body: Up to 50% for Dalit students, after verification.

items.title: Economically weaker, Janajati and other marginalised students
items.body: Scholarships are also aimed at these students.
